title: Term 3 and 4 Examination
instructions: This paper covers the work of Terms 3 and 4.
This question paper consists of 3 questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Read each question carefully before you answer it.

sections.title: QUESTION 1: Ethical Traditions and Religious Laws

questions.prompt: Define ethics.
questions.memo:
✓ Principles (1)
✓ that help us decide what is right and wrong (1)

questions.prompt: Zakat, giving to the poor, is an obligation in…
What is the Hindu principle of non-violence called?
Customary or religious law overrides the Constitution if they conflict.
Match each tradition to a guiding idea.

pairs.right: A person is a person through other people
Jewish law based on the Torah

questions.prompt: What is an ethical dilemma?
questions.memo:
✓ A situation where you must choose between options (1)
✓ each involving a conflict of moral values (1)

questions.prompt: You find a wallet with R2 000 and an ID. Describe how you would work through this dilemma using FOUR steps.
questions.memo:
✓ Identify the conflict (temptation vs honesty) (1)
✓ Consider consequences for you and the owner (1)
✓ Consider your values/traditions (1)
✓ Decide and act: return it via the police or contact the owner (1)

questions.prompt: Why did the Constitutional Court allow women to inherit under customary law?
questions.memo:
✓ Excluding women was unfair discrimination based on gender (1)
✓ which violates the right to equality in the Bill of Rights (1)

questions.prompt: Which set of rules from the Bible guides Christian and Jewish ethics? (two words: the Ten …)

sections.title: QUESTION 2: Applying for Study and Work: CVs and Interviews

questions.prompt: What does CV stand for? (two words)
Who should you list as a reference on a CV?
options: A teacher or employer who knows your work

questions.prompt: In the STAR method for interviews, what does the A stand for?
Match each item to the CV section where it belongs.
Use the STAR method to answer: 'Describe a time you showed leadership.'
questions.memo:
✓ Situation described (1)
✓ Task/challenge explained (1)
✓ Action taken by you (1)
✓ Result/outcome (1)

questions.prompt: Why should job seekers manage their social media profiles?
questions.memo:
✓ Employers may check social media before hiring (1)
✓ Inappropriate posts can cost you an opportunity (1)

questions.prompt: Name TWO documents you need when applying to a university.
questions.memo: Any two (1 each): certified ID copy; Grade 11 results / matric results; proof of income (for funding); application fee proof

sections.title: QUESTION 3: The World of Work: Labour Laws, Unemployment and Entrepreneurship

questions.prompt: According to the BCEA, what is the maximum number of ordinary working hours per week?
Which body resolves labour disputes such as unfair dismissal?
Which agency supports young entrepreneurs? (abbreviation)
Match each law to what it protects.

pairs.right: Right to join a trade union

questions.prompt: Explain THREE causes of youth unemployment in South Africa.
questions.memo: Any three (1 each): slow economic growth; skills mismatch; low education levels; lack of experience; automation; population growth

questions.prompt: Name THREE qualities of a successful entrepreneur.
questions.memo: Any three (1 each): creativity; persistence; risk-taking; financial management; networking; leadership; problem-solving

questions.prompt: Volunteering can improve your chances of finding a job.
Describe THREE steps in starting a small business.
questions.memo: Any three in a logical order (1 each): identify a need; market research; business plan; funding; register with CIPC/SARS; start small
